requirement: A registered customer can reset a forgotten password from the portal without contacting support
source: Priya Nair - Support Operations workshop 1; ticket analysis
acceptance_test: UAT-01: reset link e-mailed within 60 seconds and expiring after 30 minutes; 9 of 10 pilot users finish a reset unaided in under 3 minutes

requirement: A signed-in customer can see the current status of any order placed in the last 12 months with the carrier tracking link once it has shipped
source: 12 customer interviews; Priya Nair - Support Operations workshop 1
acceptance_test: UAT-02: for 20 test orders covering every order state the portal shows the same status as the order system and each shipped order has a working tracking link

requirement: Customers sign in through the existing identity provider (single sign-on) with their current credentials
source: Ben Adeyemi - interface analysis; Marcus Webb - security standard
acceptance_test: SIT-03: pilot users authenticate through SSO in staging; a failed provider response shows a retry message; Marcus Webb's security review is passed

requirement: Customers can search a knowledge base that answers the 50 most frequent support questions
source: Ticket analysis (top-50 questions); Priya Nair - Support Operations workshop 2
acceptance_test: UAT-04: for each of the top-50 questions the matching article is in the top three search results

requirement: Support Operations receives a weekly report of password-reset and order-status ticket volumes against the 3-month pre-launch baseline
acceptance_test: UAT-05: the report for a closed month reconciles with the ticketing system's own counts per ticket type

requirement: Every self-service journey and knowledge-base page conforms to WCAG 2.2 level AA
source: Hana Sato - accessibility policy; raised from 2.1 AA by CR003 (approved)
acceptance_test: ACC-01: an independent WCAG 2.2 AA audit reports no failures and keyboard-only and screen-reader walkthroughs of both journeys pass

requirement: Customer personal data is stored and processed only in the approved data-residency region
acceptance_test: SEC-02: a data-flow review of production and the identity-provider tenant confirms in-region storage and is signed by Hana Sato

requirement: All Support Operations agents are trained to guide customers to the portal before the pilot opens
acceptance_test: TRN-01: every agent completes the training module and passes the 10-question check before pilot launch

requirement: Support Operations can run the portal from launch using runbooks and alerting and an on-call rota it has accepted
source: Priya Nair and Ben Adeyemi - handover planning session
acceptance_test: OPS-01: in a simulated outage the on-call analyst restores service using only the runbook; runbooks signed off by Priya Nair

requirement: Customers see up to five suggested articles while typing a question in the contact form
source: 12 customer interviews; opportunity R006 (earlier ticket deflection)
acceptance_test: UAT-10: after three words are typed up to five matching articles appear within 1 second

requirement: The portal follows the customer's device dark-mode setting
acceptance_test: UAT-11: with dark mode on the dark theme is applied and still meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast

requirement: Customers can chat live with a support agent from the portal
